outliers.video_title: Bankart Repair Rehab: 9 Exercises for Weeks 0–2 (Arthroscopic Shoulder Surgery)
outliers.why_it_worked: The title gives viewers an exact protocol window (Weeks 0–2) which removes uncertainty during the most vulnerable and confusing phase of recovery. Specifying '9 Exercises' adds concrete proof that the video delivers a complete, actionable plan rather than vague advice. The surgical specificity ('Arthroscopic') signals clinical credibility and filters for exactly the right audience who is desperate for a roadmap right after their procedure.
outliers.trend_or_evergreen: evergreen — shoulder surgeries happen year-round and post-op patients will always search for week-by-week guidance during recovery
outliers.rewritten_title: Rotator Cuff Surgery Rehab: 8 Exercises for Weeks 0–2 (What Your PT Actually Wants You to Do)
outliers.rewritten_hook: Show a calendar with 'Week 1 Post-Op' circled and say: 'If you just had rotator cuff surgery, these are the only exercises you should be doing right now — and most people are either doing too much or not enough.'
